source_binding: Uncommitted frontend repair over the baseline commit, bound by the following exact file hashes; no claim that an older installed binary includes this repair.

defect.reproduction: A valid pending A design followed by invalid B numeric input was partially accepted during guarded Apply. The old loop accepted and removed A before B failed.

retained_pre_repair_receipt.location: External verification storage; original receipt preserved.

implementation: Parse every pending design/report candidate before backend transformation.
Validate designs, report settings and report issue metadata on a disposable project using existing Rust-backed transformation services.
Adopt only after every transformation succeeds and captured draft identities remain current. No intermediate state adoption or rollback-by-mutation.
One accepted batch records one undo entry. Snapshots contain only targeted designs and report fields, preserving later evidence, independent settings and untargeted designs.
Keep individual Apply actions, reject invalid batches without accepted document or history changes, retain all draft text and concurrent newer drafts.
regression_scope: Actual ReactDOM ThermalEditor, EnergyWorkspace, draft guard and useDocument lifecycle; explicit Tauri IPC doubles.
A-valid/B-invalid preparse rejection with no backend edit, accepted state change or history entry.
Final Rust-backed issue validation rejection after temporary design and settings transforms; all four draft categories and existing redo stack retained after Cancel.
All four draft categories accepted together; one undo/redo restores complete input and report changes while later run/weather evidence survives.
Failed undo retains stacks and accepted document. New accepted edits clear redo.
Concurrent newer A/B, report settings and issue drafts reject the original batch before acceptance and remain available to edit.
Targeted batch history preserves independently added attachments, sensitivity records, edit locks, untargeted design and report settings.
limitations: IPC doubles establish frontend transaction behavior, not native Rust validation or installed desktop acceptance.
WebGL follows its unavailable branch in JSDOM; these tests make no GPU/viewport/native gesture claim.
No simulation methods, scientific thresholds, engine binaries, immutable run evidence or public repository operations were changed by this repair.
Fresh packaging and exact-source Windows CI remain the coordinating agent responsibility.
